note: Four usage savers (D-023): no "noted" replies and the inspector's copies go to the board only; the inspector re-runs only changed tests plus one full run, one dark and one light picture; a hook reminds a chat to hand over and renew right after its conversation is summarized; passed site branches ship in one batch (ship.sh --with), jobs wait for the owner's notes, and read-only data is read directly. The owner picked all four.
